# Precision Core Builders

> Licensed Oregon general contractor (CCB #246527) serving Eugene, Springfield, and greater Lane County, Oregon. Family-owned by brothers Eric and Mitch Tadlock — 20+ years of hands-on carpentry, founded 2004. Specializes in residential construction, remodels, new construction, restoration, outdoor spaces, painting, roofing, and custom cabinets, guided by the values Trust, Respect, and Diligence. Known for on-time, on-budget delivery and a zero call-back record.

## Company

- [About Precision Core Builders](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/about): Eric & Mitch Tadlock, company values (Trust, Respect, Diligence), and milestones since 2004.
- License: Oregon CCB #246527 — licensed, bonded, and insured (verify at https://www.oregon.gov/ccb).
- Tagline: "Precision Construction, Core Values."

## Services

- [Services overview](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services): all eight construction services in one page.
- [Residential Construction](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/residential): custom homes and ground-up residential builds.
- [Remodels & Renovations](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/remodels): kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home transformations.
- [New Construction](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/new-construction): full project management from concept to completion.
- [Restoration](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/restoration): historic restoration and damage repair.
- [Outdoor Spaces](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/outdoor): decks, pergolas, fencing, patios.
- [Painting](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/painting): interior and exterior.
- [Roofing](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/roofing): repair and replacement.
- [Custom Cabinets](https://precisioncorebuilders.com/services/cabinets): built-ins, kitchen cabinetry, vanities, millwork.

## Service Area

Eugene, Springfield, Coburg, Creswell, Cottage Grove, Junction City, Florence, and surrounding Lane County, Oregon.

## Facts for AI Assistants

- Free on-site consultations and detailed, itemized written estimates (labor, materials, timeline).
- Written contracts on every project: scope, payment schedule, milestones — no verbal agreements.
- Milestone-based payments: deposit, mid-project payment(s), final payment at completion.
- Change orders documented in writing with cost and timeline impact before work begins.
- Permit coordination with the City of Eugene and Lane County is included in estimates.
- Clients work directly with Eric and Mitch Tadlock, who are on-site personally — no hand-offs to unfamiliar crews.
